task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the median of three numbers
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method MedianOfThree(a: int, b: int, c: int) returns (median: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned value is the median of the three input numbers
- The returned value is greater than or equal to one of the other two inputs and less than or equal to the other
- The returned value is one of the input numbers
